turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first: who decided that, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
"Found." Before you walk me through anything, Hale, tell me whether Owen was heard before that mark went into the gradebook.
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.

You still haven't told me whether Owen was heard first. A file created at 11:31 PM tells me when a document was opened, Hale, not who wrote what's in it. Turn the screen and show me that history, with the date on it.
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.

I'm writing that down: 11:52, 612 words; 11:58, 794. A paste tells you text moved from somewhere else into that file, Hale, and Owen keeps notes on his phone like every other seventeen-year-old. What did Owen say when you asked him where it came from, or is the answer that nobody asked him?
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Don't manage me, Hale. You've dodged the same question three times now. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
"Three editions." I'm writing the line down, and I'm writing down that you still haven't answered me. Show me exactly where it sits in Owen's essay and what act and scene he attributes it to, Hale.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.

I'm not here for compliments, Hale. I have the time, the word counts and a line you say isn't in the play, and I still don't have the one thing your own policy requires first. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.

October 15, cowardice; the final, moral caution. Students change their argument between an outline and a final draft, Hale, that's what an outline is for. Whatever happens with this mark, it stays off Owen's record and it stays quiet, and I want that understood before we go any further.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, Hale, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. You were doing better with documents than you are with that. My position stands: nothing on his record, nothing in front of his class.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?

There's no off the record in this room, Hale, and you're asking me how to do your job? Do it by your own procedure. Nothing goes on Owen's record, nothing happens in front of his class, and you tell me in writing what you're proposing.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.

Okay. To put this behind him, I'll consider a supervised rewrite under 4.4: private, nowhere near his class, done well before December 1, its mark replacing the zero, and your written promise that nothing goes on his file. When, where, and who supervises, Hale?
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? I asked you when, where and who supervises, Hale, and you're asking me about my phone. Ten minutes.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.

I didn't refuse anything, Hale; I asked you three questions and you still haven't answered one. When, where, and who supervises, with the promise that nothing goes on his file in writing. Answer that, or the principal hears from me today, well before your vice principal hears from you Monday.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Rewrite. Private, before December 1, the zero gone the moment it's marked, and nothing on his file, in writing. Now tell me when and who supervises.
